definitions.gloss: exploded view; breakdown diagram showing the component parts of a product
definitions.explanation: A technical illustration that shows the individual parts of a product separated out along the lines they fit together, so that the viewer can see how everything is assembled. Used in manuals, parts catalogs, repair guides, and engineering documentation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{分解|ぶんかい}→分解：08389_bunkai⟧ (disassembly, breakdown) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (figure, diagram).

USAGE:
{分解図|ぶんかいず} is a technical term that appears in instruction manuals, repair documentation, patent drawings, and parts-ordering catalogs. It refers specifically to a diagram where parts are drawn pulled apart along axes so their assembly relationships are visible — the English concept of an "exploded view."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分解図|ぶんかいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the exploded view
- {分解図|ぶんかいず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw an exploded view
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分解図|ぶんかいず}: exploded view of parts
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧な{分解図|ぶんかいず}: detailed exploded view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組立図|くみたてず}: assembly diagram — shows the parts together and how to build them up, roughly the reverse concept
- ⟦{構造図|こうぞうず}→構造図：26751_kouzouzu⟧: structural diagram — a more general term for any diagram showing internal structure
- {配線図|はいせんず}: wiring diagram — specific to electrical connections
- ⟦{設計図|せっけいず}→設計図：14805_sekkeizu⟧: design drawing, blueprint — the broader design documentation a {分解図|ぶんかいず} may be part of
